dual_strike.name: Dual Strike
dual_strike.description: Strike the target twice in quick succession, each hit dealing reduced damage.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Let out a rallying cry that temporarily boosts the attack of all nearby allies.

provoke.name: Provoke
provoke.description: Taunt a distant enemy, forcing them to target the soldier for 2 turns.

overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
overwhelm.description: Slam into a target with force, striking all adjacent units and slowing those hit.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Reaction: Brace against incoming attacks, reducing damage taken by 25%.

hp_up.name: HP Up
hp_up.description: Passive: Permanently increases max HP by 20.

veteran_stance.name: Veteran Stance
veteran_stance.description: Passive: Battle experience grants +3 ATK and +3 DEF.

advance.name: Advance
advance.description: Push forward with military discipline, extending movement range by 2 tiles this turn.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.description: Hurl a condensed bolt of raw arcane energy at a single target.

mana_drain.name: Mana Drain
mana_drain.description: Siphon magical energy from the target, dealing damage and restoring the caster's MP.

arcane_burst.name: Arcane Burst
arcane_burst.description: Channel arcane power for one turn, then unleash a burst that damages all enemies in the blast radius.

silence_shot.name: Silence Shot
silence_shot.description: Fire a bolt of null-energy that deals light damage and silences the target.

counter_spell.name: Counter Spell
counter_spell.description: Reaction: When struck by a magical attack, automatically fire an arcane bolt back at the attacker.

mp_up.name: MP Up
mp_up.description: Passive: Permanently increases max MP by 15.

arcane_focus.name: Arcane Focus
arcane_focus.description: Concentrate arcane energy to empower the next spell cast, boosting its power by 50%.

arcane_step.name: Arcane Step
arcane_step.description: Blink through arcane space to teleport up to 3 tiles to any unoccupied location.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Slam the target with your shield, dealing moderate damage with a chance to stun.

holy_blade.name: Holy Blade
holy_blade.description: Infuse your blade with holy light and strike, dealing physical and magical holy damage.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.description: Steel yourself against both physical and magical harm, gaining Protect and Shell.

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: Reaction: Step in to intercept an attack targeting an adjacent ally, taking the hit at 30% reduced damage.

sentinel_stance.name: Sentinel Stance
sentinel_stance.description: Passive: Gain +5 DEF and radiate a protective aura granting adjacent allies +2 DEF.

def_up.name: DEF Up
def_up.description: Passive: Heavy armor training permanently increases DEF by 4.

armor_march.name: Armor March
armor_march.description: March in formation this turn, ignoring all terrain movement penalties.

aimed_shot.name: Aimed Shot
aimed_shot.description: Take careful aim for one turn, then loose a powerful shot that deals heavy damage.

scatter_shot.name: Scatter Shot
scatter_shot.description: Fire a spread of arrows in a line that pierce through every unit in the path.

snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
snare_trap.description: Place a hidden snare trap on a tile; the first unit to step on it becomes immobilized.

quick_shot.name: Quick Shot
quick_shot.description: Loose an arrow instantly without aiming, dealing moderate damage at full range.

evade.name: Evade
evade.description: Reaction: When attacked, roll to dodge — 50% chance to evade the incoming hit completely.

eagle_eye.name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.description: Passive: Keen vision permanently extends attack and skill range by 2 tiles.

fleet_foot.name: Fleet Foot
fleet_foot.description: Passive: Light gear and training grants +1 permanent movement range.

iron_fist.name: Iron Fist
iron_fist.description: Channel power into your fist for a devastating punch that knocks the target back one tile.

chakra.name: Chakra
chakra.description: Focus inner energy to restore a portion of HP and gain Regen.

hundred_fists.name: Hundred Fists
hundred_fists.description: Unleash a rapid flurry of strikes — hits 5 times, each for reduced damage.

roundhouse.name: Roundhouse
roundhouse.description: Deliver a sweeping kick that strikes all enemies in a cone in front of you.

counter.name: Counter
counter.description: Reaction: When struck by a physical attack, immediately strike back at the attacker.

inner_strength.name: Inner Strength
inner_strength.description: Passive: When HP drops below 30%, deal 20% more damage from sheer willpower.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.description: Spend your action in deep meditation, restoring 20 MP through inner focus.

flash_step.name: Flash Step
flash_step.description: Blur through space in an instant, teleporting up to 2 tiles — ignoring terrain.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: Strike from behind for massive damage. Only deals bonus damage when attacking from the rear.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Hurl a smoke bomb at a location, blinding all enemies caught in the cloud.

steal.name: Steal
steal.description: Attempt to steal an item or resource from the target. Also drains a small amount of MP.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Melt into the shadows and reappear directly behind a target within range.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.description: Filch an item from an enemy's inventory with a quick sleight of hand.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Passive: After landing a killing blow, become invisible for 1 turn.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Reaction: When an adjacent enemy attacks another unit, seize the opening for a free strike.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.description: Scatter caltrops over an area — any unit entering the zone is slowed for 2 turns.

cure.name: Cure
cure.description: Channel holy energy to restore a moderate amount of HP to one ally.

curaga.name: Curaga
curaga.description: Radiate healing light around a target point, restoring a large portion of HP to all nearby allies.

raise.name: Raise
raise.description: Revive a fallen ally, restoring them to 50% of their maximum HP.

protect_spell.name: Protect
protect_spell.description: Wrap an ally in holy armor, reducing physical damage taken for several turns.

shell_spell.name: Shell
shell_spell.description: Surround an ally with a magical barrier, reducing magic damage taken for several turns.

holy_strike.name: Holy Strike
holy_strike.description: Channel divine wrath into a strike that also instantly removes the Zombie status.

faith_barrier.name: Faith Barrier
faith_barrier.description: Reaction: When struck by magic, a holy shield flares up to absorb 35% of the damage.

divine_light.name: Divine Light
divine_light.description: Passive: Holy blessings increase the potency of all healing spells by 15%.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Launch a sphere of fire that explodes on impact, burning everything in the blast radius.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Conjure a burst of freezing ice that may root those caught in the blast.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.description: Call down a bolt of lightning that strikes in a line through all enemies in its path.

quake.name: Quake
quake.description: Rupture the earth in a wide area, throwing enemies off their feet.

gale_slash.name: Gale Slash
gale_slash.description: Send a razored wind in a line that pierces all units and knocks them back.

tidal_wave.name: Tidal Wave
tidal_wave.description: Summon a massive wave that crashes over every enemy on the battlefield.

elemental_shield.name: Elemental Shield
elemental_shield.description: Reaction: When struck by an elemental attack, conjure a matching ward that nullifies the damage.

mana_font.name: Mana Font
mana_font.description: Passive: Draw from elemental ley lines — gain +10 max MP and start each battle with 20 bonus MP.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: Accelerate time around an ally, granting them Haste for several turns.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Distort time around an enemy, dramatically reducing their speed.

time_stop.name: Time Stop
time_stop.description: After a lengthy charge, attempt to stop time for all enemies on the battlefield.

hastega.name: Hastega
hastega.description: Accelerate time for the entire party, granting Haste to all allies simultaneously.

stopga.name: Stopga
stopga.description: Freeze time in an area, stopping all enemies caught in the radius.

temporal_return.name: Temporal Return
temporal_return.description: Rewind personal time to return to your position at the start of battle.

temporal_shield.name: Temporal Shield
temporal_shield.description: Reaction: Slow time around yourself when struck, reducing incoming damage by 40%.

prescience.name: Prescience
prescience.description: Passive: Glimpsing the immediate future grants +15% hit rate and +10% critical chance.

empower.name: Empower
empower.description: Enchant an ally's weapon and mind, boosting both physical and magical attack.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: Weave a subtle enchantment to charm an enemy, turning them against their allies.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Curse an enemy with a weakening hex, reducing both their physical and magical defenses.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.description: Weave a reflective enchantment on an ally, bouncing the next spell that targets them back at the caster.

dispel.name: Dispel
dispel.description: Unravel all magical enhancements on a target, stripping every active buff or debuff.

mass_empower.name: Mass Empower
mass_empower.description: After a brief charge, enchant all allies at once, boosting both ATK and MATK.

enchanted_step.name: Enchanted Step
enchanted_step.description: Blink to a location, leaving an enchanted trail that boosts the MATK of allies who cross it.

arcane_echo.name: Arcane Echo
arcane_echo.description: Reaction: Echo a weaker copy of the last spell used against you back at the attacker.

divine_judgement.name: Divine Judgement
divine_judgement.description: Channel divine wrath for one turn, then smite the target with holy power.

holy_barrier.name: Holy Barrier
holy_barrier.description: Envelop an ally in a holy aura that grants both Protect and Regen.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.description: Sacrifice half of your current HP to revive a fallen ally at 75% health.

aura_of_valor.name: Aura of Valor
aura_of_valor.description: Passive: Radiate an inspiring aura that grants allies within 2 tiles +2 ATK.

crusader_strike.name: Crusader Strike
crusader_strike.description: A holy-infused strike that cleanses one debuff from the paladin on a successful hit.

divine_retribution.name: Divine Retribution
divine_retribution.description: Reaction: When struck by a physical attack, divine light lashes back at the attacker.

holy_charge.name: Holy Charge
holy_charge.description: Surge forward in a holy charge, closing the gap and striking the target on arrival.

shadow_strike.name: Shadow Strike
shadow_strike.description: A precise dark-infused strike that poisons the target on hit.

death_mark.name: Death Mark
death_mark.description: Mark a target for death, permanently reducing their defenses until the mark is cleansed.

vanishing_act.name: Vanishing Act
vanishing_act.description: Slip into the shadows and teleport up to 3 tiles, becoming invisible for 2 turns.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.description: Slash through a line of enemies with rapid slices, dealing moderate damage and poisoning each target.

nerve_strike.name: Nerve Strike
nerve_strike.description: Strike a nerve cluster to temporarily reduce the target's ATK and SPD.

shadow_blend.name: Shadow Blend
shadow_blend.description: Passive: Blend with shadows to gain +30% evasion when on concealed terrain.

counter_kill.name: Counter Kill
counter_kill.description: Reaction: When struck, immediately retaliate with a lethal dark strike aimed at vital points.

wild_swing.name: Wild Swing
wild_swing.description: Swing recklessly, hitting all adjacent units — friend and foe alike.

blood_rage.name: Blood Rage
blood_rage.description: Enter a frenzied rage that massively boosts attack but forces uncontrolled aggression.

earthquake_slam.name: Earthquake Slam
earthquake_slam.description: Slam the ground with tremendous force, shaking the earth in a wide radius around the berserker.

brutal_charge.name: Brutal Charge
brutal_charge.description: Charge forward in a straight line, smashing through every unit in the path for damage.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.description: Reaction: When struck, immediately counterattack the attacker with a full-power swing.

savage_heart.name: Savage Heart
savage_heart.description: Passive: Lean into the rage — deal 20% extra damage while under the Berserk status.

war_frenzy.name: War Frenzy
war_frenzy.description: Enter a blind frenzy, attacking all units in a wide radius and sending yourself into Berserk.

summon_ifrit.name: Summon: Ifrit
summon_ifrit.description: Summon the fire spirit Ifrit, who scorches all enemies with hellfire.

summon_shiva.name: Summon: Shiva
summon_shiva.description: Summon the ice spirit Shiva, who freezes the battlefield and roots all enemies.

eidolon_bond.name: Eidolon Bond
eidolon_bond.description: Strengthen the bond with your eidolons, boosting the power of all summon magic.

summon_ramuh.name: Summon: Ramuh
summon_ramuh.description: Summon the thunder deity Ramuh, who strikes all enemies with judgement lightning.

summon_carbuncle.name: Summon: Carbuncle
summon_carbuncle.description: Summon Carbuncle to bestow Reflect on the entire party, bouncing the next spell targeting each ally.

spirit_guard.name: Spirit Guard
spirit_guard.description: Reaction: When struck, a guardian spirit absorbs 30% of the damage and restores 5 MP.

eidolon_step.name: Eidolon Step
eidolon_step.description: Ride the winds of the spirit world, teleporting up to 5 tiles to any unoccupied position.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: Draw down a meteor from the heavens after a long charge. Devastates everything in a massive blast.

arcane_nova.name: Arcane Nova
arcane_nova.description: Release a nova of pure arcane force in all directions, blasting every nearby enemy.

mana_void.name: Mana Void
mana_void.description: Create a void that tears the mana from a target, silencing them and draining their MP.

flare.name: Flare
flare.description: Ignite the very atoms of a single target — pure magical annihilation that ignores resistance.

ultima.name: Ultima
ultima.description: The most powerful spell in existence. After a long charge, it devastates every enemy on the field.

magic_absorption.name: Magic Absorption
magic_absorption.description: Reaction: When struck by a magical attack, absorb 30% of the damage as MP instead.

ley_stride.name: Ley Stride
ley_stride.description: Traverse invisible ley lines to teleport up to 6 tiles instantly.

grand_enchantment.name: Grand Enchantment
grand_enchantment.description: Passive: Mastery over arcane geometry expands the AoE radius of all spells by 1 tile.

void_slash.name: Void Slash
void_slash.description: Slash through space itself with dark energy, piercing enemies in a line and blinding them.

life_drain.name: Life Drain
life_drain.description: Drain the life force from a target, dealing dark damage and restoring 50% of damage dealt as HP.

dimensional_shift.name: Dimensional Shift
dimensional_shift.description: Tear through shadow-space to instantly appear adjacent to any target within range.

dark_pulse.name: Dark Pulse
dark_pulse.description: Release a pulse of void energy that detonates in a wide area, blinding those caught in it.

oblivion.name: Oblivion
oblivion.description: Channel void energy to deal massive dark damage, strip all buffs, and inflict Doom.

shadow_meld.name: Shadow Meld
shadow_meld.description: Passive: Become one with darkness — reduce all incoming damage by 20% when in concealed or dark terrain.

void_counter.name: Void Counter
void_counter.description: Reaction: When struck, phase through the void — teleport up to 2 tiles away and turn invisible.

healer.name: Pure Healer
healer.description: Dedicated support build focused on keeping allies alive.
